cheatSheet.oneLiner: Newton’s gravity, g variation, satellites, Kepler’s laws, escape speed.
mustKnowBullets: Newton’s law: F = G m1 m2 / r² (attractive).
g = GM/R² on surface; varies with height and depth.
Orbital speed for circular orbit v_o = √(GM/r); T² ∝ r³ (Kepler 3).
Total energy of circular orbit E = −GMm/(2r).
Weightlessness in satellite: effective g ≈ 0 in frame of satellite.
Kepler: orbits are ellipses; equal areas in equal times; T² ∝ a³.
